title: The Grand Inquisitor
description: An enigmatic figure, the Grand Inquisitor revealed little of his past. The Pau'an served as the leader of the Imperial Inquisitorius and led the missions to hunt many of the Jedi that had survived Order 66. He spent time on Lothal searching for Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger. He fought them in a final confrontation, but was unable to overcome. Given the option, he chose death rather than risk the wrath of Darth Vader—warning the Jedi that they had no idea what they'd unleashed.
